description: Calculates the probability of rolling a specific value consecutively for a given number of rolls on a die with specified sides using the formula (1/num_sides)^num_rolls. Returns probability as a decimal between 0 and 1. (cost: 1 credit)

num_rolls.description: integer, required, number of consecutive rolls (must be positive)

num_sides.description: integer, required, number of sides on the die (must be positive)

target_value.description: integer, required, the target value to roll (must be between 1 and num_sides)

name: probability_consecutive_rolls
